name: Counterfactual Alberta $50B (uncalibrated diagnostic)
description: A counterfactual structural test of how a ten-year AI infrastructure capital program could propagate through selected Alberta construction resources and public-delivery pressures. It is not a forecast or an aggregation of announced projects.
normalization_note: Assumed annual Alberta absorption denominators used only to create dimensionless pressure shocks. They are uncalibrated and are varied by 0.5x and 2.0x in sensitivity testing.
capture_note: A uniform local-capture assumption is used for transparency and is varied at 0.40, 0.72 and 0.90. Component-specific capture is a future calibration requirement.
exclusion_note: Computing and networking plus professional and other costs total 54% of scenario capex and are not propagated through the construction graph.
author: AIIO Canada research build
